feats.title: Accursed Isolation
feats.description: If you target only one creature with maledictor's doom, the penalty to attack rolls increases to -3, and it is a -5 penalty to opportunity attack rolls.

feats.title: Broadened Manifestation
feats.description: You can slide one or two allies with your covenant manifestation.

feats.title: Focused Wrath
feats.description: When you use your armor of wrath power and the triggering enemy is the only enemy in the burst, you deal 1d6 extra damage with that power. At 21st level, this extra damage increases to 2d6.

feats.title: Footsteps of Doom
feats.description: Each target of your maledictor's doom power gains vulnerable 5 to all damage from fear attacks until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Forceful Covenant
feats.description: Add 1 square to the distance that your Covenant Manifestation allows you to push a target.

feats.title: Invoker's Blaze
feats.description: You gain a +2 feat bonus to damage rolls with divine attack powers that have the fire keyword or the radiant keyword. While you are bloodied, this feat bonus increases to +4. At 21st level, the feat bonus increases to +3 (or +6 while bloodied).

feats.title: Invoker's Control
feats.description: When an enemy fails a saving throw against an effect caused by one of your divine attack powers, you gain a +2 power bonus to the next attack roll you make against that target before the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Overbearing Retribution
feats.description: When you use your armor of wrath power, the target falls prone after you push it.

feats.title: Pillar of Heaven
feats.description: When you miss each target with an invoker encounter attack power while using a staff, you gain a +2 bonus to all defenses until the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Preserver's Vengeance
feats.description: You gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with divine attack powers while a bloodied ally is within 5 squares of you.

feats.title: Speaker of the Gods
feats.description: When you use any Channel Divinity power, you can score a critical hit on a roll of 18–20 with the next divine attack power that you use before the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Staff of Channeled Invocations
feats.description: When you use any ranged invoker attack power through a staff, you can use the power as a melee attack with a range of 1.

feats.title: Warding Covenant
feats.description: When you use your Covenant Manifestation to slide an ally, no enemy can gain combat advantage against that ally until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Wrathful Outburst
feats.description: When you use armor of wrath, you can target any one additional enemy in the burst.

feats.title: Wrathful Panoply
feats.description: When you use armor of wrath, you gain a +1 bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn. At 21st level, the bonus increases to +2.
